chapter: Haiti, Artie Shaw and Los Angeles work
title: Private party gigs for the rich: Mexico with Nancy Wilson, Texas with Nat and Sarah
summary: Collins describes one-night private jobs: nine models flown in for a Mexican host, and a Texas country club party for ten couples.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And let's see, oh, I just came by -- I went to Mexico with Nancy I think I told you. Well, we went to Mexico, it was Nancy, Phil Wright, a conductor, pianist, and Harol Howard Jones the drummer who was with Basie, and our bass player was -- I forget his name. Any way, we went to Mexico to play a private party for this Mexican guy who had about 20 friends. So they -- they picked up all expenses, hotels, food, everything, and they brought in nine models from Nieman Marcus to model for them, and in his living, it's very small. It was not a large living room. And he flew them in from Dallas, flew them back. All this just for one night.
Just a quartet, just a quartet. Yeah, you know. And Nancy. So we played and Nancy sat down, and it was very informal and she just sang and we played for about an hour, and that was it.
Do you have many gigs like that?

Not often. I had one other gig like that. Nat and Buddy Johnson's band, and Sarah. They -- it was a lady in Wichita Falls, Texas wanted to have a little get together for her friends, I think it was around 10 couples. So she had Nat, Buddy Johnson's band, and Sarah Vaughan to come down to this country club. And we just played for about 10, 12 people. And she said she knew her friends, her other friends were going to be furious because she didn't invite them, but she didn't want to be bothered with all those people right now. She would invite them the next time she had the yen, you know.
But that happens every now and then. I remember when Charlie Barnet gave himself a birthday present of the Ellington band.
Sure, sure. It's not bad if you can afford it, it's not bad at all.
